newsitem.title: USA: SBC, partners to invest up to $100 mln each.
newsitem.headline: SBC, partners to invest up to $100 mln each.

text.p: SBC Communications Inc, one of 10 telecommunications companies participating in a proposed $1.2 billion undersea Trans-Pacific cable project, said Monday that each party is expected to invest up to $100 million.

Other companies involved in the planned submarine cable are China Telecom, Hong Kong Telecoms Ltd, Korea Telecom, Kokusai Denshin Denwa, NTT Corp, Singapore Telecom, Sprint Corp, MCI Communications Corp and AT&T Corp.
The cable project would link China, Japan, Korea and the United States. A final agreement is still pending.
